svg.desc: The agent selects construct_sql and execute_query. The application bridge adds an opaque request ID and validates tool outputs. An in-process linked MCP client/server pair looks up the turn context. Construction loads cached schema, generates SQL with the configured model, validates a single read-only query and table references, then records it. Execution checks exact equality with the validated SQL and runs a read-only database transaction. The agent loop ends after execution. The runner, not the tool-choosing agent, optionally calls summarize_results. Duplicate operations reuse per-turn promises. Cleanup always deletes the request registry entry.
svg.title: MCP query tools — inside one database turn

g.text: One shared in-memory MCP connection. separate
UUID/context per turn. no network listener
Model-facing inputs omit requestId. MCP checks
Middleware ends the agent loop once a result exists. execution is terminal
Third MCP tool. called by the runner after the loop,
Generation, execution, and summary promises are
reused within this turn. a new turn starts fresh
SQL/query errors fail the turn. Summary-only failure
keeps the table with a warning. cancellation fails the
WebSocket enables history and summaries. HTTP /api/post/agent supplies neither
